verses.text: Ix cham winhaj Samuel, ix smolb'an sb'a masanil heb' israel. Ix te' ok' heb' yuj schamel winh chi'. Ha t'a schonhab' winh t'a Ramá ix mukchaji. Ixlajwi chi', ix b'atkan winhaj David t'a tzinan lu'um t'a yol yik Parán.
Ha t'a chonhab' Maón, ay jun winh te b'eyum, oxe' mil nok' skalnel winh, jun mil nok' schiwa winh. Ay slu'um winh t'a slak'anil chonhab' Carmel, hata' sjoxel nok' skalnel winh chi'.
Ha jun winh chi', Nabal sb'i winh, yinhtilal winhaj Caleb, junelnhej te chuk spensar winh. Haxo pax ix yetb'eyum winh, Abigail sb'i ix. Ha jun ix chi', te wach' yilji ix, te ay pax spensar ix.
Ayik ayek' winhaj David chi' t'a tzinan lu'um, ix yab'an winh to a winhaj Nabal chi' ayek' winh sjoxel nok' skalnel t'a Carmel chi'.
Yuj chi' ix schekb'at lajunhwanh heb' winh schekab' winh yik b'at ak'ji stzatzil sk'ol winhaj Nabal chi',
b'at yalpax juntzanh lolonel tik heb' winh t'a winh: Syal winhaj David: Junk'olalokab' ajek' yet' masanil heb' kajan het'ok t'a yol a pat yet' masanil tas ay t'ayach.

Ix wab'i to ayach ek' a joxanel nok' a kalnel. Ojtakpaxi to a heb' a tanhwum kalnel aynhejek' heb' ket'ok t'a Carmel tik. Ayik ayek' heb' ket'ok t'a tik, malaj jab'ok tas ix ik'an heb', malaj pax jab'ok tas ix kik'ek' t'a heb'.

Syal a k'anb'an juntzanh chi' t'a heb' a chekab' chi'. Ha heb' ol halan t'ayach chajtil to yel. T'a wal sk'ual jun a k'inh tzonh jawi, yuj chi' stewi winhaj David t'ayach to tzonh a cha t'a wach'il, tzak'an t'ayonh tastak ay t'ayach. Ak'paxkot yik winhaj David a wach'k'o'ol, xchikot winhaj David t'ayach, xe chi, xchi winh.

Ayik ix k'och heb' winh schekab' winhaj David chi' t'a winhaj Nabal chi', ix yalan heb' winh masanil tas ix yalkot winhaj David chi', ix lajwi chi' ix kan heb' winh stanhwej spak ol yal winhaj Nabal chi'.
Palta ix yalan winhaj Nabal chi' icha tik: --¿Tas yaj winhaj David yuninal winhaj Isaí chi'? Ha tiknaik manh jantakok winak tz'el t'a heb' yajal, icha chi' yaj jun winh chi'.
Max yal-laj wak'an swa'el yuk'el yet' schib'ej heb' in joxum kalnel tik t'a heb' anima manh wojtakok, manh wojtakokpaxi b'aj skoti, xchi winh.
Icha chi' ix aj smeltzajxi heb' winh schekab' winhaj David chi'. Ayik ix k'och heb' winh t'a winh, ix yalan heb' winh masanil tas ix yal winhaj Nabal chi'.

Yuj chi' ix yal winhaj David chi' t'a masanil heb' winh ajun yet'ok: --E masanil, ik'ek k'e'en eyespada, xchi winh. Masanil heb' winh swinak winh chi', ix yak'och yespada heb' winh t'a snanhal, icha ix yutej yik winh chi'. Chanhe' ciento heb' winh winak chi' ix b'at yet' winh, haxo chab' cientoxo heb' winh jun, ix kan heb' winh stanhwej sk'a'el heb' winh.

Haxo ix aj jun, ay junok heb' winh schekab' winhaj Nabal ix b'at halan t'a ix Abigail ix yetb'eyum winhaj Nabal chi' icha tik: --Hato t'a lum tzinan lu'um ix schekkot juntzanh heb' winh schekab' winhaj David t'a winh in patrón tik, yik ix ul ak'ji stzatzil sk'ol winh yuj heb' winh, palta te chuk ix yutej winh slolon t'a heb' winh.

Palta jun, a juntzanh heb' winh chi', wach'nhej ix yutej sb'a heb' winh t'ayonh ayik ix onh ek'nhej tanhwoj kalnel b'aj ayek' heb' winh chi'. Maj onh stzuntzej jab'ok heb' winh, malaj jab'ok tas ix yik'ek' heb' winh t'ayonh.
k'ual t'ak'wal ix onh stanhwej heb' winh ta' yakb'an sko tanhwej nok' kalnel chi'.

Palta icha wal winh in patrón tik, toton wal junelnhej chuk winh, max yal-laj ko lolon yet' winh. Na' a ach tik, tzilan tas tza k'ulej, yujto t'a wal yel ay wal tas manh wach'ok ol ja t'a kib'anh yet' winh, xchi jun winh chekab' chi'.

Elanhchamel ix yal ix Abigail chi' to tz'ik'chajkot chab'ok ciento pan, chab'ok tz'u'um b'ut'an yuj wino, owanhok nok' kalnel tonhej b'olb'il yet' oyeok arroba ixim trigo k'anb'inak, cien b'uyanhok sat uwa takjinak yet' pax junok cien kechanh te' higo takjinak yaman yaji. Ixlajwi chi' ix ak'jioch t'a yib'anh juntzanh nok' b'uru.
Ix yalan ix t'a heb' schekab' chi': --B'ab'lajanhek, tzak'anto ol in b'at eyu'uj, xchi ix. Malaj tas ix yal ix t'a winh yetb'eyum chi'.

Ix k'e ix t'a yib'anh jun nok' b'uru, ix em ix t'a jun utzin b'e tz'em t'a jun ch'olan. Haxo ix yilan ix to wan yemul winhaj David t'a yichanh ix yet' heb' winh ajun yet'ok, yuj chi' ix b'at ix scha winh.

Ix yal winhaj David chi' t'a heb' winh ajun chi' yet'ok icha tik: Nab'anhej ko tanhwejnak nok' smolb'etzal nok' winhaj Nabal chi' t'a tzinan lu'um. Malaj wal jab'ok tas kik'nak ek' t'a winh, palta ko tanhwejnhejnak nok' skalnel winh chi'. Te chuklaj syutej winh spaktzitan ko wach' pensaril chi'.
Yuj chi' swala': Aokab' Dios tz'ak'anoch in ya'elal tato pitzanto winhaj Nabal chi', ma junokxo winak t'a skal heb' sk'ab' yok winh k'ik'an yab' icha tik.
Ayik ix yilanb'at winhaj David ix Abigail chi', ix emta ix t'a yib'anh nok' b'uru chi', ix em nhojan ix t'a sat lu'um.
Elanhchamel ix em nhojnaj ix t'a yichanh winh, ix yalan ix: --Ha chukal ix sk'ulej winh wetb'eyum, kotokab' t'a wib'anh. Tzin tewi t'ayach to tzin a cha lolon jab'ok, tzab'an tas ol wala'.

Manh ak'och winhaj Nabal chi' t'a a k'o'ol. Ha jun winh chi', kistal winh, smojton wal sk'ulan winh icha sb'i chi'. Malaj spensar winh, yuj chi' anhej chukal pensar syal winh. Ha in pax a chekab' in tik, maj wil-laj heb' winh a chekab' ix a chekb'ati.

Palta jun, a Jehová ix ach kachan wanajok ayik t'inhan a milancham anima yuj a paktzitan schukal heb' t'a a patik. Elokab' t'a sk'ol Jehová to a heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayach yet' heb' snib'ej tzach ixtani, kotokab' t'a yib'anh heb' icha wal tz'aj skot t'a yib'anh winhaj Nabal chi'.
Haxo tiknaik jun, tzin tewi t'ayach to a jab' silab' swik'kot tik t'ayach, tza pukb'at t'a heb' winh a chekab' ajun tik het'ok.
Tzak'an niwank'olal t'a in patik a in a chekab' in tik. Wal yel a Jehová ol ochnhej het'ok t'a opisio yet' heb' inhtilal, ina to yuj Jehová tzak' owal, malaj chukal pax tza k'ulej.

Wach'chom ay mach tzach pechan b'eyek'ok, snib'ej heb' tzach smilchamok, malaj tas ol ach ik'anok, yujto k'ub'ab'il ach el yuj Jehová ko Diosal. Haxo pax heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayach jun, a Jehová ol julanel heb' icha junok mach sjulanel junok k'e'en k'e'en yet' junok mejme'ech.

Yujto tza cha ab' tas swala', yuj chi' ayik ol elk'och masanil tas wach' ix yal Jehová t'a ib'anh, ol ach tzalajok ayik ol a na'ankoti to maj ak'och a k'ab' a milancham heb' malaj smul ayik ijan ix ak'anek' a pak t'a heb' chuk ix yutej sb'a t'ayach. Ayik ol ach yik'ancha'anh Jehová yet' opisio, tzin a nakot a in a chekab' in tik, xchi ix t'a winh.
Ix tak'wi winhaj David chi' t'a ix icha tik: --Aljokab' wach' lolonel t'a Jehová ko Diosal a onh israel onh tik to ha' ix ach chekankot ul in a cha'a.
Yak'okab'pax swach'k'olal t'a ib'anh yujto te wach' a pensar, yujto a ach tzin a kach wanajok yik max in milcham anima yik swak'anek' in pak t'a heb'.

Palta a tiknaik, swak' in ti' t'ayach t'a yichanh Jehová ko Diosal, haton jun in kachanoch wa'an wak'an chukal t'ayach, tato maj a pil ip a kot ul in a cha'a, k'ik'an manhxo pitzanok winhaj Nabal, manhxa pax junok winak t'a yinhtilal winh tzato kani, xchi winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix scha'anek' winh masanil tastak yet'nak ix chi', ix yalan winh: --Wach' tzach meltzaj t'a a pat t'a tzalajk'olal. Tik wal scham hilani to ix wab' tas ix ala', tzin k'anab'ajan tas ix a k'ana'.

Ayik ix meltzaj ix Abigail chi' b'aj ayek' winhaj Nabal chi', ix yilan ix to ayoch jun k'inh yuj winh icha sk'inh heb' winh rey. Te chamnak winh yuj anh, ste tzalaj winh, yuj chi' malaj tas ix yal ix t'a winh, hato t'a junxo k'u.
Ayik ix k'inhib'i t'a junxo k'u chi', ayik toxo ix el anh t'a sat winhaj Nabal chi', ix yalan ix tas ix uji, yuj chi' ix och jun yab'il t'a yol sjolom winh, ix sikb'iel sniwanil winh yuj.
Lajunhe' k'ual ix och jun yab'il chi' t'a winh, ix cham winh yuj Jehová.

Ayik ix yab'an winhaj David to toxo ix cham winh, ix yalan winh icha tik: --Aljokab' wach' lolonel t'a Jehová yujto toxo ix yak'ek' in pak t'a winhaj Nabal yuj tas ix in yutej winh. Ha Jehová chi' ix in kachanoch wa'an yuj tas chuk ijan ix in k'ulej. Hanheja' ix ak'ankot ya'elal t'a yib'anh winhaj Nabal chi' yuj schukal, xchi winh. Ixlajwi chi' ix yak'anb'at schekab' winh t'a ix Abigail yik b'at yal heb' winh to snib'ej winh syik' ix.
Ayik ix k'och heb' winh chekab' chi' t'a ix t'a Carmel, ix yalan heb' winh: --Ha winhaj David ix onh chekankot t'ayach, to snib'ej winh tzach och yetb'eyumok, xchi heb' winh t'a ix.
Ix em nhojan ix, ix yalan ix: --Ha in tik schekab' in winh, te b'ekan in k'ol in b'ikan yok heb' schekab' winh, tato icha chi' syal winh t'ayin, xchi ix.

Ayik ix lajwi yalan ix icha chi', ix sb'o'an sb'a ix elanhchamel, ix kot owanh heb' ix schekab' ix yet'ok, ix k'e ix t'a yib'anh jun nok' b'uru, ix och tzak'an ix yuj heb' winh schekab' winhaj David chi'. Icha chi' ix aj yik'an ix winhaj David chi'.
Ix yik'anpax ix Ahinoam winh, haton jun ix aj Jezreel. Ha heb' ix chawanh chi' ix och yetb'eyumok winh.
Yujto a winhaj Saúl, toxo ix yak' ix yisil winh ix Mical t'a winhaj Palti, yuninal winhaj Lais aj Galim. Ha ix Mical chi', haton ix yetb'eyumtaxon winhaj David chi'.
